notes.n5: Audi UK 1.4 TFSI 122 PS S tronic technical data sheet (legacy_research_sources:d36a12aece1e, status September 2011; the PDF is no longer served) gives the 7-speed S tronic (DQ200) gear set 3.500 / 2.087 / 1.343 / 0.933 / 0.974 / 0.778 / 0.653, reverse 3.988, and two gearbox output final drives, 4.800 (1-2) and 3.429 (2-3); 3.429 is the one behind the top gear (see the final-drive note) and is the only one stored. Production start 2010 (UK Q4 2010 launch); the row's 2011 follows the model-year convention. The earlier 0.680 top gear and 3.786 final drive were placeholders.

final_drive_front.notes: The official Audi technical-data sheet (Audi UK A1 1.4 TFSI 122 PS S tronic, status September 2011, as recorded in legacy_research_sources:d36a12aece1e; the PDF is no longer served) prints two gearbox output final drives, 4.800 (1-2) and 3.429 (2-3), not separate front and rear axle ratios. Of every way to run the forward ratios 3.500 / 2.087 / 1.343 / 0.933 / 0.974 / 0.778 / 0.653 through the two outputs, only those with the top gear on 3.429 keep the overall ratios falling gear by gear (for example 4th 0.933 x 4.800 = 4.478, 5th 0.974 x 3.429 = 3.340, 6th 0.778 x 3.429 = 2.668, 7th 0.653 x 3.429 = 2.239; 7th on 4.800 would give 3.134), so 3.429 is the final drive behind the top gear and is stored as final_drive_front; 4.800 drives only lower gears and is not stored as an axle ratio. The row previously stored 4.800, the output behind the lower gears.

verification_notes.note: Checked official Audi launch and facelift sources. Official launch-period 1.4 TFSI technical sheets already show separate 122 PS S tronic and 185 PS S tronic states, and later facelift brochures add further 1.4 TFSI S tronic variants. This single represented 2011 DCT row therefore remains a mixed-power, mixed-era advisory placeholder rather than one exact production-safe configuration.
